figurative_meaning_en: Sudden nouveau riche or someone who suddenly becomes wealthy and acts pretentiously
example_sentences_in_bangla: লটারি জিতে সে হঠাৎ নবাব হয়ে গেছে, এখন খুব দেখানোর ভঙ্গি করে।
গ্রামের ছেলেটি শহরে গিয়ে ব্যবসা করে হঠাৎ নবাব হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: After winning the lottery, he suddenly became a Nawab, now he shows off a lot.
The village boy went to the city, started a business, and suddenly became a Nawab.
history: Refers to the historical Nawabs of Bengal, who were Muslim rulers and nobles during the Mughal and British eras, symbolizing sudden elevation to elite status with accompanying ostentatious behavior.
note: The idiom mocks the pretentious lifestyle of those who gain wealth abruptly, mimicking the grandeur of historical Nawabs.
